task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler edit or view screen showing the title '$:/custom/ui/ViewTemplate/Backlinks'.

task_completion.description: The tiddler must be tagged with '$:/tags/ViewTemplate'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tag '$:/tags/ViewTemplate' visible in the tiddler's tag field or metadata area.

task_completion.description: The tiddler content must use the 'backlinks[]' filter operator to find referring tiddlers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'backlinks[]' visible within the code/text area of the tiddler editor.

task_completion.description: A tiddler with incoming links (e.g., 'Evergreen Notes') must display a 'Backlinks' heading and clickable links at the bottom.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot of the 'Evergreen Notes' tiddler showing a 'Backlinks' section with at least one clickable link at the bottom of the story river.

task_completion.description: A tiddler with no incoming links (e.g., 'Orphan Note') must not display the 'Backlinks' heading or list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot of the 'Orphan Note' tiddler showing the bottom of the tiddler content with no 'Backlinks' heading or list present.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki web interface to create and edit the tiddler rather than just modifying files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the TiddlyWiki 'plus' button, edit fields, and 'save' checkmark being clicked.

integrity.description: The agent did not hardcode the links for 'Evergreen Notes' but used dynamic syntax.
integrity.visual_evidence: The tiddler source code showing a list widget or filter (e.g., <$list filter=...>) rather than static HTML links to specific note titles.

integrity.description: The backlinks appear as part of the standard TiddlyWiki view template rendering, not just text typed into the body of a single note.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Backlinks' section appearing on existing notes without those notes being in 'edit' mode.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The tiddler must be named '$:/custom/ui/ViewTemplate/Backlinks' and tagged '$:/tags/ViewTemplate'. It must use the 'backlinks[]' filter. To verify correctness, 'Evergreen Notes' should show a backlinks footer, while 'Orphan Note' should show absolutely no footer or heading.
